verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs describe capturing traces of model calls over OTLP, with auto-instrumentation for popular frameworks and SDKs (including OpenAI) and manual tracing decorators. They also list specific features for spotting slow LLM invocations (latency) and a detailed breakdown of token usage per LLM call, and a community user reports using Phoenix traces in practice. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that prompt inputs and completion outputs are recorded as span attributes (only implied by span replay and 'see exactly what happened'), and stronger independent hands-on corroboration.
